obligations.label: Data Platform Migration
quotes:
Nimbus will migrate Customer's advertising performance data from its existing on-premise warehouse to the
Nimbus Platform, comprising discovery and mapping, construction of the extract-transform-load pipelines, two
parallel-run cycles, and cutover.
The fixed fee for the work described in Section 1 is USD 240,000

Cutover is achieved when Customer's production reporting runs entirely on the Nimbus Platform for five (5)
consecutive business days without a severity-one defect.

variable_consideration.description: Fixed fee reduced by USD 2,500 per complete week of delay where cutover is achieved after February 28, 2026 for reasons attributable to Nimbus, capped at USD 25,000.

personnel, does not count towards the reduction in this Section.
